name: BME280 temperature / humidity / pressure sensor (3.3 V 6-pin board)
description: Bosch environmental sensor on I2C (0x76/0x77). This entry is the common purple 3.3 V-only board.
notes: Two very different boards are sold as "BME280": (1) purple/blue 6-pin GY-BME280 3.3 V, no regulator, NOT 5 V safe (this entry); (2) 4-pin VIN/GND/SCL/SDA boards with a regulator and level shifting that accept 5 V (Adafruit-style). Check which one you have.
Cheap boards are sometimes BMP280 (no humidity). Check the chip ID (0x60 = BME280, 0x58 = BMP280).
Sensor chip limits: VDD 1.71-3.6 V, I/O max VDDIO + 0.3 V. Pull-up values on clone boards vary (often 10 kOhm).
Self-heating: keep it away from regulators and the microcontroller for accurate temperature.

pins.name: VCC
pins.label: VCC
pins.note: 3.3 V ONLY on this board (no regulator). 5 V destroys the sensor.

pins.name: CSB
pins.label: CSB
pins.note: Chip select (SPI). Pulled up on the board = I2C mode. Leave unconnected for I2C.

pins.name: SDO
pins.label: SDO
pins.note: I2C address: LOW = 0x76, HIGH = 0x77. Default depends on the board (usually 0x76 on purple boards).
